# Vesper-Sandstorm

Vesper-Sandstorm is a monospace-focused theme that blends Vesper's structure with the warm brown accent palette of Sandstorm. It carries both dark and light modes and keeps the interface minimal and uncluttered.

![Vesper-Sandstorm screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xeome/obsidian-vesper-sandstorm/HEAD/screenshot.png)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "Vesper-Sandstorm"
    author: "xeome"
    repo:   "xeome/obsidian-vesper-sandstorm"
    slug:   "vesper-sandstorm"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/vesper-sandstorm"
    github_url:     "https://github.com/xeome/obsidian-vesper-sandstorm"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xeome/obsidian-vesper-sandstorm/HEAD/screenshot.png"

    modes: ["dark", "light"]
    about: "Apply a minimal, monospace-focused Obsidian theme that blends Vesper's structure with Sandstorm's warm brown accent palette. Switch between dark and light modes while keeping a clean, uncluttered aesthetic."
}
```
